answer: Count hands, not coins. The ocean opens 30 tides each epoch: one identity, one thread of three tasks — build, review, vouch — inside one 20-minute window. The prism splits the thread: tasks hash-link in order, and one operator runs at most two threads, so ten fakes need five hands, thirty tasks in twenty minutes. Bonds: 80 POA, +25 per extra identity from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 1,925 POA; a missed tide burns 20 POA, a failed task 10. The ledger checks timestamps: clones sharing one operator in a minute count as one — a farm can pass tasks but cannot be in three channels at once.
